Karim

Overview

Karim serves Rindeil and formerly performed on stage. He knows the estate’s gossip and helps turn rumours about a red-skinned attacker into useful information. Through a bribed guard he obtains a report connected with the necromancers and Kir’s search for other Joons. [1, 2, 3]

Shelter at Rindeil’s estate

Rindeil welcomes Kel and her companion to his estate. Kir’s learning gives them common ground, though the collector’s chief concern remains his spiders. Karim, who manages the household and formerly performed on stage, becomes a source of contacts and rumours about another Joon. Feiruz helps Kir hide his conspicuous face beneath cloth, exploiting the fear of disease. Rindeil’s requests include obtaining a meteorite sample in exchange for a rare specimen for his collection. This period of refuge lets Kir search for information, but its safety depends on the owner’s willingness to risk his household. [4, 1, 5, 6, 7, 8]

The report and the passage to Gipath

Karim’s rumour about the missing red-skinned youth becomes a document recovered from the necromancers. It records transformation and teleportation before the attack on the scholars’ mansion, with Gipath as the destination. Kir decides to follow that Joon. Sahilia supplies enlistment papers, and Kel refuses to be left behind, passing as a young man herself. Sergeant Zairak puts them through military training in Death Canyon. Their performance earns a courier assignment to the Gipath expedition. Sealed orders and a portal pass finally let them leave Suslanger under the authority of the same empire that enslaved them. [8, 2, 3, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13]
